## Initial Report
_Reporters: Please fill all info as completely as possible_

### Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Context
- Who found this? Who can we contact for additional details?
  - Name
- What model/configuration?
  - UnitType
- Which unit/setup, and where is it?
  - LabQaEtc
- What software versions?
  - BundleBoardHashEtc
- When was this discovered?
  - Date

### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected behavior (link to requirements)
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Pictures
If applicable, add screenshots or pictures to help explain your problem.

### Additional context and details
Add any other context about the problem here.

## Investigation
_Following sections will be filled during/after investigation_

### Triage and Assessment

#### Involvement
What boards/repos/etc require changes to fix this? What programs will be impacted? Be sure to update labels accordingly.

#### Impact
Who will see this? Does it impact users? Factory? QA? etc

#### Severity
How bad is it?

#### Likelihood
Is this common? Reproducible? etc

### Root Cause
What caused this bug to occur?

### Resolution
What changes are being made to fix the bug?
